Interface TermsAndConditions

All Known Implementing Classes:
TermsAndConditionsJson
public interface TermsAndConditions
A set of Equinix Internet Access (EIA) terms and conditions, as returned by the v1 terms lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/terms).

This is a read-only response view.
